title: Qualify strict catalogue boundaries and preserve inherited source for parity
commitMessage: feat: qualify bounded catalogue resolution and capture AURA parity sources

contribution.summary: Extend the standalone exact-unit resolver with bounded candidate discovery and canonical ID lookup; verify alias ambiguity, culture isolation, symbol case, token limits and BigInteger exact roundtrips; capture both full pinned AURA mathematical catalogue sources for a later explicit parity review.
contribution.value: Adds a stronger deterministic unit-catalog boundary with eight independent qualification tests and durable full-source review material, without claiming unverified source parity or expression-parser compatibility.
debtChanges: The AURA standard catalogue (11 KB) and expression resolver (3 KB) remain adaptation references; full approved source texts are captured in Math for parity review, not compiled or claimed equivalent to the 14-unit subset.
The inherited expression resolver depends on dw.quantities.expression and accepts a culture argument; later T2-V must explicitly reconcile that API and catalog IDs, aliases, constants and omissions.
Only M1-W02-C01-T2-G is completed; T2-V and the phase stay open pending source-by-source parity decisions. No sibling repository is modified.
contribution.nextAction: Review both captured AURA catalogue sources, construct a defensible inherited-unit parity ledger, qualify or explicitly defer each relevant alias/profile family, and complete T2-V only when C01 acceptance is demonstrably satisfied.

achievements.achievement: The standalone catalog adds bounded deterministic alias candidate discovery and exact canonical ID lookup; eight independent boundary tests, locked solution build, full quantities tests and foundation regressions pass, and both owner-authorized AURA source texts are captured by pinned SHA for transparent parity review.
